notes: BETA: fixes the 'pdfplumber not available' error when reading Deluxe Vanity PDFs (the cryptography dependency wasn't bundled). Also bakes in Deluxe pricing: the PO's NET price is the sale rate, and our cost is computed as MSRP x 0.40 (NET / 0.45 gives the implied MSRP), so a $729 NET line shows $729 sale and $648 cost. Pick the .pdf in Step 1 and Build Preview.
